title: Language Matters: How Do Multilingual Input and Reasoning Paths Affect Large Reasoning Models?

bias_targets.methodology: Controlling the internal reasoning language of models using language-specific prefill tokens and evaluating performance disparities on reasoning tasks (MATH-500, MMMLU) between high-resource (e.g., English, Chinese) and low-resource languages (e.g., Swahili, Telugu).

Evaluating nuanced cultural understanding on the CulturalBench-Hard dataset by comparing model performance across 30 geographical regions when reasoning in English versus the native language associated with the specific cultural context.

Measuring the Attack Success Rate (ASR) on translated LMSYS-Toxic prompts to assess how the choice of internal reasoning language (English vs. native target language) affects the model's likelihood of rejecting toxic requests or generating toxic responses.
